text:
anya: short sync 10 quant-matmul kernel v2.14.1-quant landed in staging. proposing a fast-canary tonight 22:30 UTC with thermal and kv-cache mitigations. need pin policy, prebake, and rollback signals. cc @devon @maria

 tj: build artifacts look good. note: enabling new fp16-accel path by default for this bundle. fallback path (fp32) exists but is ~1.4x slower. we should instrument `quant-fallback-rate`.

 maria: suggested ramp: 5% for 15m, then 20% for 20m, then 60% for 25m. region stagger: eu -> na -> ap. require prebake: `deploybot prebake --bundle kernel-v2.14.1-quant --selector hot-nodes` before cutover.

 devon: recommend sticky-node pin after cutover for 1h: `deploybot pin --selector sticky-nodes --ttl 3600`. also add bundle signature verification step; last week we had a stray upload.

 tiffany: QA note: perf-ci saw a kv-cache leak in a long-run stress test (1/30). link: https://ci.redwood/tests/5721. saw gradual mem growth on sparse-attention workload. if OOM reproduces on canary, we should pause.

 perf-ci: failing job attached: https://ci.redwood/tests/5721  repro added. heap dumps available.

 anya: mitigation set: on canary hosts set `cache_max_entries=200000` and `lru_fraction=0.55`, enable `debug.kv_trace=true` for 60m. auto-revert triggers: quant-fallback-rate > 2%, OOMs > 0.8 per host per 30m, 5xx spike > 0.4% absolute. manual kill switch still required.

 devon: sounds good. I'll add a short ephemeral dashboard `dash/quick-canary-v2.14.1` with deltas vs baseline for P50/P95/P99, fallback-rate, oom-count. also wire alerts to #infra-alerts with low severity first, escalate if persistent.

 deploybot: scheduled cutover job created for 2026-03-21T22:30:00Z. dry-run result: PASS. planned commands: `deploybot prebake --bundle kernel-v2.14.1-quant`, `deploybot cutover --bundle kernel-v2.14.1-quant --canary 5 --canary-duration 900 --stagger eu,na,ap --ramp 20,60`, `deploybot pin --selector sticky-nodes --ttl 3600` (manual).

 ops-bot: pin simulation: `deploybot pin --selector sticky-nodes --ttl 3600` -> OK. prebake simulation OK on hot-nodes.

 tiffany: I'll standby at 22:15 for prebake verification and will run the long-run reproducer on the canary image. if leak reproduces, I'll snapshot heaps and pause.

 devon: owner timeline: I own the manual rollback window until 23:30 UTC, then @anya takes over. rollback play: 1) `deploybot revert --to kernel-v2.14.0-stable` 2) `deploybot pin --selector all --ttl 3600` 3) run `ops/notify-customers --impact minimal|partial|major` if >5% affected.

 anya: add small safety: mark 10% of traffic as sticky to older kernel pre-cutover for instant fallback. command: `deploybot prepin --bundle kernel-v2.14.0-stable --pct 10`.

 devon: also include a binary-signature check in preflight: `bundlectl verify --bundle kernel-v2.14.1-quant`. don't skip.

 anya: final check: prebake + dry-run PASS, dashboards wired, QA on standby, owners assigned, rollback steps documented in release notes draft. proceeding unless objections in next 20m. :rocket:
